# TraceMantle verification corpus v1

40 focused initial cases: 20 skill inputs and 20 comparison scenarios. All are authored for this repository and redistributed under its MIT license. Comparison scenarios are synthetic policy tests, not claims of agent execution. The eight held-out text cases are a separate authored source family spanning four prose languages, two code forms and small/large inputs. They are excluded from implementation tuning. Their token reference is cl100k_base, not a vendor runtime success label. Advisory calibration is insufficient to claim trigger reliability or task success.

The separately retained Promptfoo fixture has its own upstream license and provenance.
